key_findings: A one-pot alkynylation-heterocyclization route yielded steroidal diosgenin pyrazoles and alkynyl hydrazones; the 5-phenyl pyrazole conjugate showed anti-inflammatory activity comparable to diclofenac in histamine-induced paw edema.
Docking predicts the new diosgenin derivatives bind the Keap1 Kelch domain with higher affinity than diosgenin.
